items.title: Ricard Alexis Interview, 1959-01-16
items.q: Yes I worked with him with Bob Lyons band.

ctx.x: Yeah. Didn't get all the members of the Bob Lyons band. You have the trumpet and who was clarinet? Sidney Bean. That's right. Sidney Bean.

When he was a skeleton trombone. Yes indeed. Yes I worked with him with Bob Lyons band. He worked with us with Bob Lyons band. August Rousseau. He had a mommy shop uptown years ago. Was he a Routiner or what? Was he a Routiner or a reader? He could read. Yeah. Nice old man.
Did he have a play with someone? Yeah. Did he have a play with someone?
